orca worktree

Usage: orca worktree <command> [options]

Commands:
  list               List Orca-managed worktrees
  show               Show one worktree
  current            Show the Orca-managed worktree for the current directory
  create             Create a new Orca-managed worktree
  set                Update Orca metadata for a worktree
  rm                 Remove a worktree from Orca and git
  ps                 Show a compact orchestration summary across worktrees

Run `orca worktree <command> --help` for command-specific usage.
